query: Reconcile these completed experiment, interview and telemetry reports without averaging away their disagreement.
What do these five evidence streams jointly warrant once shared data sources and assumptions are accounted for?
Build a conflict and defeater ledger from these research outputs and give me a multidimensional confidence profile.
The reports disagree, but they use different populations and time horizons. Work out which conflicts are real and which are scope differences.
Synthesize findings expressed in two conceptual bases and be explicit where the crosswalk is partial or lossy.
Trace each conclusion back to raw evidence and show where apparently separate reports depend on the same instrument.
Generate alternative frames for our vague engagement problem.
Plan what evidence and methods we should collect next; no studies have run yet.
Calculate the required sample size for the proposed experiment.
Choose whether we launch based on this already synthesised Epistemic Profile.
Run an independent audit of the whole investigation.
Summarise this single article in five bullets.
